entries.title: Psalms 54:1
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Name - By thy own strength. Judge - Plead my cause.

entries.title: Psalms 54:3
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Strangers - The Zephites, whom, though Israelites, he calls strangers in regard of their barbarous and perfidious carriage.

entries.title: Psalms 54:5
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Thy truth - Whereby thou art engaged to fulfil thy promises and threatenings.
